items.briefing:
ASIC has warned that scammers are increasingly using AI to create convincing deepfake videos and fake investment networks targeting Australians — making it harder than ever to spot a scam. Separately, AUSTRAC has put banks on notice over coordinated mortgage fraud involving false information on loan applications, which may affect customers whose details have been misused. A China-linked hacker group has also been observed using AI tools in attacks across the Asia-Pacific region, a reminder that cyber threats in our region are growing more sophisticated.

**Practical tip:** If you see an investment opportunity promoted by a video of a well-known person, verify it through official channels before engaging — deepfakes are now highly realistic.

featured.title: PCI council marks 20 years with AI focus in Kuala Lumpur
featured.summary: Banks and merchants face fresh fraud risks as the council's Kuala Lumpur meeting weighs how AI is changing payment security.
